provenance.v12_preliminary_generic_filter_test: taxonid=1299 18-24ka returned two different IDs than same taxonid 100-200BP, sentinel and taxonid3461 returned empty, but sample ages and taxon IDs were not examined.

individual_evidence_check.record_occurrence_id: occid unique; duplicate same id not independent fossil evidence
individual_evidence_check.taxonid: sample.taxonid MUST equal requested numeric Neotoma taxon ID; otherwise status invalid_filter
individual_evidence_check.plant_name: sample.taxonname MUST be exact selected source binomial, not just genus (if present)
individual_evidence_check.proxy: site.datasettype MUST match requested pollen/plant macrofossil source label
individual_evidence_check.age: age.age numeric strictly 18000<=age<=24000 BP. ageolder/ageyounger uncertainty retained but sample age model not necessarily verified
individual_evidence_check.site: site.siteid and site.location retained as raw site metadata; no historical occupancy claim until sedimentation/deposition age provenance and site location validated independently
individual_evidence_check.limit: 30 per selected query, NOT an exhaustive source search or species absence inference

uncertainties: Neotoma API age query may intersect dataset age range rather than strictly select sample ages
Even taxonid and age matching does not confirm a source-calibrated age-depth model, dating error or transported pollen's provenance
Species-level pollen identification may not be morphologically independent; no species occupancy confirmation
Two temperate model plants selected for API technical viability are not representative of all 416 native WCVP hosts
Never accept generic no-data response as biological absence or infer any host-specific genetic effect
TTF and chocho negative known-host vs climate-matched other-plant LGM results remain fixed
